llm.summary: The package claims to be an htpasswd manager (create/verify Apache/Nginx basic-auth entries) but the shipped script only manages generic JSONL 'entries' and does not produce or verify standard htpasswd entries — the functionality and claims are misaligned.

dimensions.detail: The description promises htpasswd entry generation, verification, and management for Apache/Nginx. The included script implements a generic entry manager that stores JSONL records (field 'text') in a per-user data directory; it does not create classic username:hashed-password htpasswd files, perform password hashing/verification, or integrate with webserver configs. That mismatch means the skill will not deliver the core advertised capabilities.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md is minimal and directs users to run the provided htpasswd CLI. The runtime script only reads/writes files under the user data directory (config.json and entries.jsonl) and prompts for confirmation on reset. It does call python3 for JSON parsing; python3 is implied but not listed as a required binary. There are no network calls or attempts to read system-wide credentials or unrelated files.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only) and only a single script is included. Nothing is fetched from remote URLs or installed globally by the skill itself, which is low-risk from an install perspective.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no credentials or special environment variables. It respects HTPASSWD_DIR if set and falls back to XDG_DATA_HOME/HOME — normal behavior. It will read HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME implicitly; no unexplained secrets are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request elevated privileges or system-wide configuration changes. It stores data in a per-user data directory and does not modify other skills or global agent settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This package is inconsistent with its description. The script behaves like a simple note/entry manager that appends JSON lines to entries.jsonl — it does not produce .htpasswd format lines, perform password hashing/verification, or manage webserver auth configs. Do not rely on it for real password storage or authentication. If you intended to manage Apache/Nginx basic auth, prefer well-known tools (e.g., the system 'htpasswd' from apache2-utils or utilities that explicitly produce bcrypt/MD5/crypt-formatted entries). Before installing or using this skill: inspect the script yourself, ensure python3 is available, avoid storing real credentials in entries.jsonl, and consider running it in a sandbox. If the author intended true htpasswd behavior, request clarification or an updated implementation that outputs standard htpasswd entries and documents hashing/verification methods.
